description: A map \(f:A\to B\) is bijective if and only if there is a map \(g:B\to A\) satisfying both \(g\circ f=\operatorname{id}_A\) and \(f\circ g=\operatorname{id}_B\).
signature:
Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.{u, v} {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {f : α → β} :
  Function.Bijective f ↔ ∃ g, Function.LeftInverse g f ∧ Function.RightInverse g f
